extends Node
# Creates one stylized tree in view_1. All geometry belongs to this script session.

func run(viewer) -> void:
	var view = viewer.viewport("view_1")
	if view == null:
		push_error("Viewport view_1 is unavailable.")
		return
	var tree: Node3D = viewer.content("view_1")
	tree.name = "LowPolyTree"
	var bark := make_material(Color("#765038"))
	var branch_bark := make_material(Color("#8b6142"))
	var leaves: Array[StandardMaterial3D] = [
		make_material(Color("#35774a")),
		make_material(Color("#438a50")),
		make_material(Color("#559b57")),
		make_material(Color("#6aaa60"))
	]

	add_branch(tree, "Trunk", Vector3(0, 0, 0), Vector3(0.04, 2.65, 0), 0.23, 0.07, bark)
	for i in range(6):
		var angle := float(i) * TAU / 6.0
		var tip := Vector3(cos(angle) * 0.48, 0.045, sin(angle) * 0.48)
		add_branch(tree, "Root_%02d" % i, tip, Vector3(0, 0.43, 0), 0.025, 0.13, bark)

	var tips: Array[Vector3] = [
		Vector3(-0.95, 2.5, 0.12),
		Vector3(0.87, 2.55, 0.18),
		Vector3(-0.12, 2.6, 0.87),
		Vector3(0.20, 2.75, -0.80),
		Vector3(-0.62, 3.08, -0.42),
		Vector3(0.57, 3.18, 0.40)
	]
	for i in range(tips.size()):
		var start := Vector3(0.02, 1.2 + float(i) * 0.18, 0)
		var joint := start.lerp(tips[i], 0.58) + Vector3(0, 0.13, 0)
		add_branch(tree, "Branch_%02d" % i, start, joint, 0.095, 0.055, branch_bark)
		add_branch(tree, "Twig_%02d" % i, joint, tips[i], 0.055, 0.018, branch_bark)

	var centers: Array[Vector3] = [
		Vector3(-1.00, 2.55, 0.12), Vector3(0.95, 2.63, 0.18),
		Vector3(-0.12, 2.64, 0.87), Vector3(0.20, 2.78, -0.78),
		Vector3(-0.65, 3.12, -0.42), Vector3(0.59, 3.18, 0.43),
		Vector3(0.02, 3.52, 0.03), Vector3(-0.48, 2.93, 0.52),
		Vector3(0.62, 2.91, -0.39), Vector3(-0.58, 2.60, -0.51),
		Vector3(0.04, 3.12, -0.14), Vector3(0.37, 2.42, 0.57)
	]
	var sizes: Array[Vector3] = [
		Vector3(0.72, 0.65, 0.68), Vector3(0.76, 0.69, 0.66),
		Vector3(0.73, 0.62, 0.68), Vector3(0.76, 0.71, 0.64),
		Vector3(0.70, 0.73, 0.68), Vector3(0.74, 0.70, 0.70),
		Vector3(0.70, 0.72, 0.66), Vector3(0.69, 0.69, 0.64),
		Vector3(0.70, 0.72, 0.62), Vector3(0.64, 0.60, 0.61),
		Vector3(0.78, 0.74, 0.73), Vector3(0.58, 0.55, 0.59)
	]
	for i in range(centers.size()):
		var crown := MeshInstance3D.new()
		crown.name = "Foliage_%02d" % i
		var mesh := SphereMesh.new()
		mesh.radius = 1.0
		mesh.height = 2.0
		mesh.radial_segments = 10
		mesh.rings = 5
		crown.mesh = mesh
		crown.material_override = leaves[i % leaves.size()]
		tree.add_child(crown)
		crown.position = centers[i]
		crown.scale = sizes[i]
		crown.rotation = Vector3(0.09 * float(i % 3), 0.71 * float(i), 0.08 * float(i % 4))

	view.frame_bounds(AABB(Vector3(-1.9, -0.12, -1.7), Vector3(3.8, 4.55, 3.4)))
	print("Added LowPolyTree to view_1: trunk, roots, branches, and 12 foliage clusters.")

func make_material(color: Color) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	material.albedo_color = color
	material.roughness = 0.94
	return material

func add_branch(parent: Node3D, label: String, start: Vector3, end: Vector3, bottom: float, top: float, material: StandardMaterial3D) -> void:
	var direction := end - start
	var mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
	mesh.bottom_radius = bottom
	mesh.top_radius = top
	mesh.height = direction.length()
	mesh.radial_segments = 9
	var branch := MeshInstance3D.new()
	branch.name = label
	branch.mesh = mesh
	branch.material_override = material
	parent.add_child(branch)
	branch.position = (start + end) * 0.5
	branch.basis = Basis(Quaternion(Vector3.UP, direction.normalized()))
